# Convolution

The convolution of two signals mixes one into the other, in Hebrew קונבולוציה:

$$ (f * g)(t) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(\tau)\, g(t - \tau)\, d\tau $$

Inline math like $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ renders in the paragraph. See [[lecture-2-notes]] for the next part.
